pictures.name: well_that_never_runs_dry
pictures.scene: an old stone well with clear water standing high in its shaft and a worn rope over the rim, the wet stone lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the yard above and behind it quiet and dim

pictures.name: bent_stalk_lifted_by_a_prop
pictures.scene: one heavy grain stalk that had fallen over now carefully propped upright on a forked stick, the ear and the prop lit warm and gold low in the frame, the standing crop above them soft and even

pictures.name: birds_at_a_full_feeding_ground
pictures.scene: a scatter of small brown birds feeding on spilled grain across a swept threshing floor, the nearest birds and grain lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the yard beyond them dim and open

pictures.name: open_granary_full_of_grain
pictures.scene: a granary door standing wide with the grain heaped up to the top inside it, the golden slope of grain lit warm and full at the bottom of the frame, the roof beams above it dark and quiet and high

pictures.name: level_water_channel
pictures.scene: a stone irrigation channel running dead straight and brimming with clear water across a field, the moving water lit bright and warm low in the frame, the crop and sky above it soft and green and calm

pictures.name: near_spring_beside_the_track
pictures.scene: a small clear spring rising in a basin of rock right beside a well worn footpath, the water and the stone lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the hillside above it quiet and dim and open

pictures.name: full_cup_on_a_stone_ledge
pictures.scene: a plain clay cup filled right to its brim standing on a broad stone ledge, the water in it catching one warm low light at the bottom of the frame, the wall above the ledge plain and dim and bare

pictures.name: sheepfold_wall_at_dusk
pictures.scene: a low round wall of dry stone closing a fold with its narrow entrance kept clear, the near stones lit warm and low at dusk, the hills and sky above it deepening into a quiet and settled blue

pictures.name: dawn_wind_through_barley
pictures.scene: a wide field of ripe barley moving all one way in a light dawn wind, the nearest ears lit warm and gold along the bottom of the frame, the field beyond them going pale and soft toward the horizon

pictures.name: wide_land_full_of_life_at_morning
pictures.scene: a broad green country of trees and water and pasture opened out under clean morning light, the near meadow lit warm and bright, the far hills above it soft and blue and altogether wide and quiet

lines.text: The LORD is faithful in all His words
and kind in all His actions.
The LORD upholds all who fall
and lifts up all who are bowed down.
The eyes of all look to You,
and You give them their food in season.
and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
The LORD is righteous in all His ways
and kind in all His deeds.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him,
to all who call out to Him in truth.
He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him;
He hears their cry and saves them.
The LORD preserves all who love Him,
but all the wicked He will destroy.
My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD;
let every creature bless His holy name
